canonical_utterance: Покажи по дням количество реализаций и среднюю цену покупателя за октябрь 2026 на Озоне

source.plan: Enumerate requested days and all source pages once; same source rows feed both measures.

leaves.realization_units: SUM(posting.products.quantity) over qualified positive commission rows

expressions.monthly_average: SUM(customer_realization_amount) / SUM(realization_units), not average of daily averages

line_contract.multi_unit_projection: sale_price / quantity is the line average; individual receipt prices inside that line are not separately observed

limits: Only prices of realized units are observed.
Acquisition date is not proven order or receipt date.

architecture: One shared source adapter, row grouping, additive measures and a division expression. No separate fixed phrase or API script per calendar month. DeepSeek may select a bounded plan; it must not do money arithmetic.
requires_before_runtime_enable: Integrate reviewed source into the shared queue, transport allowlist, source quota ledger and exact cache
Register the definitions and speech aliases with an explicit accrual-date meaning
Retain context when clarifying order vs accrual vs receipt date
Regression suite and cloud Alice acceptance
Implement returns separately rather than silently subtracting unrelated fees
